/Users/dm/miniconda3/bin/python3 -I -B - <<'EOF'
import hashlib,json,os,re
from pathlib import Path
r=Path('.').resolve()
def h(p): return hashlib.sha256((r/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
out={}
for p in ['eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/c24-receipt.json','eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/preflight-report.json','plugins/system-spec-harness/.claude-plugin/plugin.json','plugins/dev-graph/plugin-composition.yaml','plugins/system-spec-harness/references/package-contract.json','system-spec/spec-state.json','system-spec/fetched-references.json','.dev-graph/state/graph.json']:
    out[p]=h(p)
for n in ['run-system-spec-elicit','run-system-spec-doc-fetch','run-system-spec-compile','assign-system-spec-completeness-evaluator']:
    p=f'plugins/system-spec-harness/skills/{n}/SKILL.md'
    rp=(r/p).resolve(strict=True); rp.relative_to(r/'plugins/system-spec-harness')
    out[p]=h(p)
    txt=rp.read_text(); m=re.search(r'^name:\s*(\S+)',txt,re.M); out[p+':name']=m.group(1) if m else None
print(json.dumps(out,indent=1))
m=json.loads((r/'plugins/system-spec-harness/.claude-plugin/plugin.json').read_text()); print(sorted(m))
# harness file basenames vs dev-graph
hs={f for _,_,fs in os.walk('plugins/system-spec-harness') for f in fs if f.endswith(('.py','.md'))}
dg=[os.path.join(d,f) for d,_,fs in os.walk('plugins/dev-graph') for f in fs]
print('dup basenames:',sorted({os.path.basename(x) for x in dg} & {f for f in hs if f not in ('SKILL.md','README.md','CHANGELOG.md')}))
print('system-spec-ish in dev-graph:',[x for x in dg if re.search(r'system.?spec|spec.?compile|elicit|doc.?fetch|completeness',x,re.I)])
print('harness exposes .claude-plugin files:',os.listdir('plugins/system-spec-harness/.claude-plugin'))
EOF
